sections.title: Before booking in Kingston
sections.html:
Ask whether a future Kingston session is confirmed, where it will take place and which packages will be offered. If makeup is your main concern, compare the basic colour work with the more detailed makeup review rather than choosing on duration alone. Keep a written record of the appointment date, cancellation terms and what happens if the visiting event changes.

  • When is the next confirmed Kingston appointment date?
  • Does my chosen package include makeup review and follow-up?

sections.title: Make the result useful in your everyday wardrobe
sections.html: While waiting for availability, explore one palette and two outfit combinations at home. The app can help you build a short list of questions for a later consultation. Bring examples of what still feels uncertain, such as a difficult neutral or two similar lip colours. That makes the eventual appointment more useful than repeating a broad request to be told your season.
